name: Chichen Itza
description: The Kukulkan pyramid anchors a major Maya archaeological site on the Yucatán Peninsula.

name: Teotihuacan
description: Avenue of the Dead links the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon northeast of Mexico City.

name: Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral
description: A vast cathedral faces the Zócalo on the site of the former Aztec sacred precinct.

name: Palacio de Bellas Artes
description: An Art Nouveau and Art Deco palace of murals and performances beside Alameda Central.

name: Monte Albán
description: Zapotec ruins crown a flattened hilltop overlooking the Oaxaca valleys.

name: Casa Azul (Frida Kahlo Museum)
description: Frida Kahlo’s blue courtyard house in Coyoacán is now a museum of her life and work.

name: Zona Hotelera beaches
description: Caribbean beachfront hotels and public access points line Cancún’s barrier island.

name: Guanajuato historic centre
description: Colourful houses and tunnels fill a UNESCO mining-city core in the highlands.

name: Copper Canyon viewpoints
description: A vast canyon system with rail viewpoints on the Chepe route.

name: Isla Mujeres
description: A small Caribbean island near Cancún with beaches and a ferry link.

name: Mercado Roma
description: A gourmet food hall in Roma Norte with Mexican and fusion counters.

name: Mercado Medellín
description: A neighbourhood market in Roma Sur known for produce and casual eats.

name: Mercado 20 de Noviembre
description: Oaxaca City’s market is famous for moles, cheeses and chocolate.

name: Mercado San Juan de Dios
description: A vast indoor market in Guadalajara selling crafts, produce and street food.

name: Puebla historic centre kitchens
description: Birthplace flavours of mole poblano and cemitas fill central Puebla eateries.

name: Día de Muertos
description: Altars, marigold-lined cemeteries and processions mark early November commemorations.
